verdict.rationale: NVIDIA docs confirm 141GB HBM3e at 4.8TB/s per H200 SXM, well beyond what's needed to host a 70B-class quantized model on a single GPU, and community evidence corroborates real-world large-model inference (Llama 405B at 142 tok/s in production) on H200 SXM hardware. Independent commentary also confirms the memory capacity/bandwidth figures are real (though same die as H100), supporting practicality for single-node inference. Missing for 10: no direct hands-on benchmark specifically for a 70B quantized model on a single H200.
